headline: Congress takes a breather with pro forma sessions scheduled for both chambers as next week's agenda shapes up.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Thursday, October 15 and adjourned without conducting legislative business. The chamber will reconvene Monday for another pro forma session.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Thursday, October 15, introducing 30 public bills and 5 resolutions during a short session. No votes were held as the chamber adjourned after just over an hour.
